**Is your feature request related to a problem?** Describe it.

**Proposed solution** — and, if you can, which layer it belongs in:

- [ ] Core engine (posting/reversal/reporting)
- [ ] Database schema
- [ ] Plugin (`docs/plugin-guide.md` — tax packs, dashboards, workflows)
- [ ] Keyboard-first UI (`docs/keyboard-ux.md`)
- [ ] Documentation
